title: Money split
skill: Name the algorithm and the tie-break

good: Rewrite split(cents, ratios) in src/money/split.js with the largest remainder method. Rules: 1) cents must be an integer >= 0 (Number.isSafeInteger), else throw; 2) ratios must be a non-empty array of numbers that are finite and > 0 (no 0, negatives, NaN, Infinity, strings), else throw; 3) each share starts as Math.floor(cents * r / sum); 4) give the cents that are left one at a time to the shares with the largest fractional part, and on a tie to the earlier index (sort by remainder desc, then index asc); compare remainders as cents * r - share * sum so equal ones stay equal; 5) return integers in ratio order that always add up to cents. Example: split(100, [1, 1, 1]) is [34, 33, 33], split(2, [1, 3]) is [1, 1]. Keep the signature. Do not change other files. Then run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/*.test.js
lazy: The bill split sometimes loses a cent. Fix split().
